Container.Name: audiobookshelf-hardcover-sync
Container.Overview: Sync Audiobookshelf reading progress, book status, and ownership with Hardcover. Manage sync profiles in the web UI. Set the Audiobookshelf URL before starting, then add profiles and API tokens in the web UI. Global token fields are available for migration from an existing config.yaml. Keep the appdata directories when updating or reinstalling, including the generated encryption key. Authentication is disabled by default; use only on a trusted network until authentication is configured.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port for the web UI. Change the host port if 8080 is already in use; keep the container port at 8080.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent database, encryption key, sync state, caches, and mismatch reports. Back up this directory and retain it across updates.

Config.Name: Configuration
Config.Description: Optional config.yaml directory. No config file is required when using the template variables. Environment variables override YAML settings.

Config.Name: Audiobookshelf URL
Config.Description: URL reachable from this container, for example http://192.168.1.10:13378. Required even when configuring tokens in the web UI.

Config.Name: Audiobookshelf API token
Config.Description: Global Audiobookshelf API token for migration from config.yaml. Configure new profile tokens in the web UI.

Config.Name: Hardcover API token
Config.Description: Global Hardcover API token for migration from config.yaml. Configure new profile tokens in the web UI.

Config.Name: Enable web UI
Config.Description: Enable profile management in the web UI. If false, both API tokens must be supplied.

Config.Name: Sync interval
Config.Description: Periodic sync interval as a Go duration, for example 30m or 1h.

Config.Name: Dry run
Config.Description: Set true to preview sync actions without changing Hardcover.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: IANA time zone, for example America/New_York.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: Logging level: debug, info, warn, or error.

Config.Name: Enable authentication
Config.Description: Enable login. Also set an admin password and session secret before enabling.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Initial password for the default admin user when authentication is enabled. Does not reset an existing account password.

Config.Name: Session secret
Config.Description: Long random secret for authentication sessions. Keep the same value across restarts.

Config.Name: Data directory
Config.Description: Container directory for persistent data and the generated encryption key.

Config.Name: Database path
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite database path inside the container.

Config.Name: Sync state file
Config.Description: Base path for persistent sync state; profiles use separate state files.

Config.Name: Cache directory
Config.Description: Persistent cache directory inside the container.

Config.Name: Mismatch directory
Config.Description: Persistent mismatch report directory inside the container.
